title: The Sixteenth Scholarship
author: N. M. Yarrow
blurb: Hazel Eriksen, the new kid at a school built over something old, stays under the radar: head down, grades up, locker shut. But when the teacher pairs nemesis with nemesis for a semester-long project, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must save the tradition that made the town before the final audition.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
